description: Turns a pitch into a second pitch a chosen ratio away, for setting up frequency modulation pairs; the knob moves smoothly between ratios or locks onto exact ones

params.text: Sets the frequency ratio between the two pitches, -16 to 16; positive multiplies the frequency and negative divides it, with everything between -1 and 1 reading as unison
Attenuverts the ratio CV before it is added to the ratio knob
Snaps the ratio to the nearest half on each press and lets it move freely on the next

inputs.text: The pitch the ratio is applied to, read as a volt per octave
Shifts the ratio, added to the ratio knob through its attenuverter; a polyphonic cable gives each voice its own ratio

outputs.text: The pitch with the ratio applied, which is the input plus the base-two logarithm of the ratio; the ratio is held between a sixteenth and sixteen

notes: with nothing in the input jack the output carries the ratio on its own as a voltage from 0V, which makes it a plain interval source
menu: Ratio Non-Linearity — a slider from 1 to 5 bending the knob's travel so that the whole-number and half-number ratios occupy more of it; at 1 the travel is even

inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
